notes: Existing 5 stories already cover required breakdown (schema/contract, core logic, API, integration, tests). Minor clarifications applied to strengthen contract and integration intent without creating duplicates.

change_log.value: Explicitly define service interface contracts (Pydantic schemas, request/response models, and boundary rules) across facades, domain services, and infrastructure layers, enforcing strict input/output validation and no cross-layer leakage per ARCH-001.

Refactor and isolate core business logic into discrete domain services (provider_search, specialty, clinical_trials, provider_detail, consent, safety), enforcing pure domain boundaries and eliminating shared-state or cross-service coupling.

Align application facades and FastAPI endpoints to consume modular services via defined contracts, preserving external API behavior and ensuring compatibility with tool_router and existing tool schemas.

Implement dependency wiring and service orchestration across layers (facade → domain → infrastructure), ensuring unidirectional flow, no circular dependencies, and runtime configuration consistency with ARCH-001.

Validate refactor via unit, integration, and regression tests ensuring contract adherence, service isolation, and full behavioral parity with pre-refactor baseline including UAT scenarios and E2E flows.
change_log.note: Strengthen testing scope to include contracts
